source_title: SEGA UFO Catcher Excellent sound collection
source_machine: UFO Catcher Excellent (1994), not UFO CATCHER 10
assignment_note: Actual recorded audio excerpts. The simulator assigns these excerpts to its own events; this does not reproduce the exact UFO CATCHER 10 sound sequence. Motion phases share one real-machine BGM excerpt.
production: Trim, loudness normalization, short edge fades, PCM WAV conversion. No sound synthesis or app playback test.
